verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean centered column and the original hierarchy, but the SOLSTICE wordmark is clipped by the bottom of the shortened header band. The headline, body and CTA are separated by big uneven dead gaps, and the legal text is microscopic. B is worse: the header band floats about 55px down with an empty cream strip above it, and the eyebrow is jammed into the header. The body copy and CTA drift left of the centered headline's axis, so the alignment looks ragged and arbitrary, and B has the same large dead gaps.
